annotation_type: Technical source review by Codex; exploratory, not independent human ground truth
scope: Direct calls and explicitly identified allocation/free/copy/formatted-stdio/block/file-IO operations plus named wrappers supported by local caller context. Raw array/asm accesses and unresolved codecs/macros/helpers are separately noted and excluded from callsite recall. A true operation is not a vulnerability.
review_exposure: Reviewer had previously inspected E1 implementation and some E1 predictions. Annotation is not blind to the method.

samples.notes: Returns byte from gb during range-coder refill, guarded by bytes-left query. Wrapper body absent; classification supported by explicit byte-use context.
Register/code-generation helpers and MASK/SH/MB macros; do not infer host memory sinks from guest load/store names.
Direct frame-plane array writes are present and outside callsite-only scope. decode_sym body unavailable; keep helper semantics unresolved.
Two structure zeroings and cleanup of initiator_name. iscsi create/destroy and async-connect operations remain unresolved resource/IO helpers without implementations.
av_realloc result assigned to ret then *ptrptr; two explicit failure/zero-length cleanup branches. Function definition av_reallocp_array is not a call.
Actual formatted stderr output; MMIO writes only mentioned in text. A diagnostic-output call is not proof of a dangerous format vulnerability.
Direct writes to callback table fields; assert checks are not sinks. Callback is assigned, not invoked here.
Class cast macro and set_bit helper. Body of set_bit is not provided; do not infer a validated call-family.
Numeric conversion/get_param_value helpers and scalar arithmetic; option-buffer writes inside helper remain unresolved. No selected-scope direct allocation/copy/file call.
Stream-array traversal and scalar comparison, no selected-scope callsite. Array safety is outside this benchmark.
Explicit teardown: buffers/metadata/context cleanup and URL handles closed. av_write_trailer and RTP/RDT parser close helpers remain unresolved compound operations.
Allocation by sizeof(CharDriverState), null check, matching free if console creation fails. new_console and timer creation require helper contracts.
Four buffer allocations assigned to liveness arrays and three syntactic memset sites. Count lexical sites, not loop execution frequency.
Alternative paths read block sectors into dest or copy secn<<9 bytes from current mapping. Conditional bdrv_read is a real call.
LUT field writes and residue macros; search_for_golomb implementation absent. Do not count macro/type declarations as confirmed API calls.
Ring-read helper and generation/barrier logic. The apparent DMA read is an unresolved helper without its implementation, not scored as an annotated direct IO API.
Only direct assignments to exception-vector array under preprocessor branch; no callsite in scope.
DISAS_INSN macro definition and TCG generation helpers; no resolved host operation in scope. Macro expansion is not available.
Raw pointer reads/writes and AV_RL16/32 endian macros are relevant but outside resolved direct-call scope. av_log is an unexpanded logging wrapper, not standard fprintf.
Direct pixel-array arithmetic in RENAME template. No direct API call; macro-selected function name is not invocation.
Dictionary/reference lifecycle and indirect monitor handler calls require type/helper resolution; not falsely labeled as no security-relevant operations.
CPU register/codegen helper calls, not established host copy/file API calls.
Integer overflow condition and exception helper. No selected-scope call; arithmetic correctness outside this measurement.
Complex H264 decoder orchestration, bit-reader and loop-filter helpers/macros; unknown semantics not turned into No-Sink. Diagnostic strings containing overread are not read() calls.
File opened/closed on non-pipe path; packet allocated then freed on read failure. pgm_read/yuv_read/ppm_read and filename formatting helpers remain unresolved compound IO/copy operations.
Duplicate opt into mutable arg, parse with strtok, then free arg. Count real fprintf call independently of string contents; strtok parsing excluded from chosen sink-call scope.
Motion-vector helpers and indirect put_pixels_tab[index](...) buffer kernel; not resolved by direct-call annotation.
Open descriptor, modify mode/ownership, close descriptor on common exit. Counts are independent of vulnerability label.

Two quantization-table copy sites, frame allocation checked for null, and three stats-buffer allocation sites. ffv1_allocate_initial_states and slice initialization are unresolved compound alloc helpers; av_log not in direct stdio scope.
Template with output_pixel helper/macro and array operands. Pixel stores may occur but body unavailable; no confirmed registry-style call in scope.

Two explicitly typed allocation macros: MSI record and int key, then fields assigned and hash-table insert. IRQ block allocation/release are non-heap resources, retained unresolved outside chosen scope.
COPY macro locally expands to struct-field assignment, not libc memory copy; no allocation/IO sink claimed from the name COPY.
Two plane-buffer cleanup sites inside loop; count 2 sites, not 6 runtime calls.
Extension match and indirect format read_probe. Probe implementation/type effects unknown; no selected-scope resolved call.
Stream private-data cleanup. put_be32/put_flush_packet appear only in comments; flush_packet implementation not supplied.

Response bytes copied from req->resp into response iovec using explicit size; request cleanup after queue notification. scsi_req_unref lifetime effects unresolved. Wrapper classification inferred from caller roles, not audited helper body.
Preprocessor alternatives restore CPU state via codegen helpers, not direct host sink-call families.
Three bounded formatting sites advance p within buf; fprintf reports invalid format. put_packet transport implementation unresolved; no assertion that all p increments remain safe.
Raw pixel-array reads/writes with clipping. No selected-scope call API; not evidence of no memory sink.
Indirect DSP transform callback and av_log wrapper; unresolved callback performs computation on buffers, outside direct-call scored scope.
RENAME uses initialize function pointers; no kernel invocation here. Preprocessor/rename macro semantics not mistaken for memory API.
Allocate basename, copy filename, append suffix with basename_size, cleanup basename and format context. Header-writing/init helpers unresolved; actual helper safety not inferred.
Inline asm and scalar preprocessor alternatives directly write image buffer. No direct API call; MANGLE/ASMALIGN/RENAME not scored sink calls.
mc is a function-pointer parameter; indirect pixel kernel is unresolved. Guard offs/ref_offs does not prove buffer capacities.

Explicit allocation into swapped_buf with capacity field, and three alternative frame-buffer acquisition sites. bswap16_buf indirect copy and decode functions remain unresolved; log-only conditions do not prove guards.
Bitreader macros plus direct out[0] stores. Macro bodies absent; no direct selected-scope API call.
Scalar popcount loop, no calls or direct buffer IO. Empty annotation is scoped to callsite operation detection.
Read QEMUFile state into queue/next/priority pointer destinations. Classification inferred from explicit file-source and destination roles; wrapper bodies not expanded.

Input function itself is incomplete: missing closing braces and no completed outer definition. chr lookup and backend init unresolved. Review only visible text; retain context-defect flag, not a safe judgment.
MMIO address switch returns array/scalar fields. omap_badwidth_read32/OMAP_BAD_REG are unresolved error helpers, not confirmed read API calls.
